description: Use for VMware Private AI Foundation with NVIDIA on vSphere 9.x/VCF 9.1: GPU inventory/readiness/utilization, vGPU consumers and profiles, DirectPath catalog, vGPU assignment, and PAIS served models, knowledge bases, catalogs/data sources and MCP gallery. Trigger on "list GPU hosts", "which VMs use a vGPU", "GPU utilization", "assign a vGPU profile" or "list served models" in VMware/NVIDIA context. Supporting commands check access, estimate model sizing locally and inspect local air-gap bundles without contacting a model provider. For backing VM power/snapshot/clone/migrate use vmware-aiops, general health/alarms vmware-monitor, or GPU-enabled Tanzu Kubernetes vmware-vks.
